data.exact_reserve_text: Prior closed years continue to run off satisfactorily both in the aggregate and individually, with all years but one contributing releases to the closing year result. The losses that impacted the 2012 account, which were reported on in detail in the last two years Annual Reports, ran off as expected during 2014 and there were releases from the favourable run off of the earlier years of account that had closed into the 2012 account at 31 December 2013.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Contained within our reinsurance arrangements; prior closed years ran off as expected and contributed to releases to the closing year result.

named_events.loss_description: Sandy is well contained within our reinsurance arrangements.
Landfall of Hurricane Odile spurred rates in Mexico during late summer.
A major tornado system caused widespread damage in Nebraska; notable impact on catastrophe account.
Another round of German storms during the summer affected the catastrophe account.
The tragic losses of two Malaysian Airlines aircraft hit the market; impacted 2013 and 2014 years of account but are protected by comprehensive reinsurance.
Air Asia A320 loss referenced alongside Malaysian Airlines losses; affected aviation account.
A substantial and complex war loss at Tripoli Airport impacted the aviation/war account.
Cancellation of part of the Rolling Stones tour was a noteworthy contingency loss.

named_events.event_name: Paul McCartney Far Eastern tour cancellation
named_events.loss_description: Cancellation of the Far Eastern leg of Paul McCartney's tour was a noteworthy contingency loss.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2014 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 295.177m. During 2014 there were favourable run-off and releases from prior closed years (2001-2011) which contributed positively to results and enabled the 2012 year to close with a significant profit; these releases are described in the report but no single gross prior year movement amount is provided. The releases are attributed to favourable claims development and recoveries under the reinsurance programme. Some 2014-specific adverse events (e.g. Nebraska tornadoes, German storms, aviation losses including two Malaysian aircraft and an AirAsia A320 and a Tripoli war loss) affected open years but were largely protected by reinsurance.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross prior year movement (gross movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding) is disclosed in the notes. The report contains narrative statements indicating releases from prior closed years and provides closed year profit figures, but does not present a single gross PYD amount. Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is left null. Loss development data is presented as gross loss ratio percentages (a loss ratio triangle) rather than an absolute gross claims development triangle; no per-underwriting-year gross premiums were provided to convert the percentage changes into absolute GBP  amounts.
